open_points.subject: Run.status when waits include both approval and outcome_unknown/service_unreachable
open_points.text: M19: "its status is `awaiting_approval` when any of them waits for the owner's approval, otherwise `pending`"; K-08: "When the kernel cannot tell whether an effect happened, the run rests `pending` with reason `outcome_unknown`".
open_points.question: If a run simultaneously has an `owner_approval` wait and an `outcome_unknown` (or `service_unreachable`) wait on another node, which single run status is required?
options: `awaiting_approval` takes precedence whenever any approval wait exists
`pending` takes precedence whenever any pending reason exists
such mixed waits are forbidden and must not occur

open_points.subject: Action revoke standing grant (M25 lifecycle / primary action semantics)
open_points.text: Primary action row specifies only: "granting an already granted node returns the active grant" and failure "a `destructive` node cannot be granted"; M25 only defines lifecycle "`active` → `revoked`".
open_points.question: What must happen when revoke is called but there is no active grant for that flow-version node (never granted, or already revoked)?
options: idempotent success returning current non-active state
create/keep a revoked record even without a prior active grant
open_points.default_guess: Idempotent success if a grant exists and is already revoked; otherwise refuse unknown/no-active grant.

open_points.subject: Slot.purpose mutability (M02)
open_points.text: M02 includes `purpose` as a Slot field, while Slot lifecycle says only "Created; no retirement in this kernel" and there is no separate update action.
open_points.question: After slot creation, can `purpose` ever change (for example on later contract-author calls for the same slot)?
options: may be updated by later author calls on the slot
may be updated only by a separate action (not currently defined)

open_points.subject: Flow.purpose mutability (M12)
open_points.text: M12 includes `purpose` as a Flow field, while Flow lifecycle says only "Created; no retirement in this kernel" and there is no separate update action.
open_points.question: After flow creation, can `purpose` ever change when composing later versions under the same flow name?
options: may be updated by later compose-and-prove calls
may be updated only by a separate action (not currently defined)
